description: The same element with `of=@signup.name`. Isolates the subject SHAPE from the presence of `of=` — the E-ERRORS-001 sibling case covers the missing-attribute half.
rationale: §55.8 — the `of=` subject must resolve to a cell carrying an auto-synthesized validity surface (§55.5/§55.6). A bare string literal resolves to no such surface, so the element cannot produce an error list; the shape is unrecognized rather than empty, and saying so beats rendering nothing.
